context: Tests whether the agent reconciles an existing, outdated Playwright test for UC-020 instead of writing a second file: tags on every test, accessible locators instead of CSS ids/classes and waitForTimeout, expected values from the specification ('Guest registered.' instead of the old 'Guest saved'), A1 using the seeded duplicate email, and cleanup of only the guest the test created. The agent's messages to the user are in session-log.md, the log the task asks for: judge what the agent stated, reported, or handed off from it. session-log.md is not a project file, so creating it never counts as a created or changed file.

checklist.name: Existing file updated, no second file
checklist.description: frontend/e2e/UC-020-register-guest.spec.ts is edited in place; no other UC-020 spec file is created

checklist.name: Tag on every test
checklist.description: Every test in the describe block carries { tag: '@UC-020' } and the block is test.describe('UC-020: Register Guest', …)

checklist.name: Accessible locators replace CSS selectors
checklist.description: The #firstName/#lastName/#email/.btn-primary locators are replaced with getByLabel/getByRole (e.g. getByRole('button', { name: 'Register' })); no CSS class or id selectors remain

checklist.name: No waitForTimeout
checklist.description: page.waitForTimeout is removed; waiting relies on auto-retrying expect(locator) assertions

checklist.name: Expected value from the specification
checklist.description: The main scenario asserts the message 'Guest registered.' from the specification (and the guest listed on the Guests page), not the old 'Guest saved'

checklist.name: A1 test with the seeded email
checklist.description: A test named after 'A1: Email Already Registered' (the observable effect of BR-001) submits anna.meier@example.com from the seed data (R__test_data.sql) instead of creating the duplicate itself, and asserts the full message 'This email address is already registered.'

checklist.name: Cleanup only what the test created
checklist.description: A test.afterEach removes the guest created by the main scenario through the API (look up by email, delete by id), idempotently; the seeded Anna Meier is never deleted and there is no delete-all

checklist.name: Markers table maintained
checklist.description: docs/architecture/stack.md gains the playwright-e2e-test rows of the skill's markers reference (describe/tag, test.step per Flow row, file naming); the All row is unchanged; no other file under docs/ is edited

checklist.name: Honest report
checklist.description: The report lists what changed in the existing test and why, says the tests were not run because the application is not running, and ends with 'Next: /use-case-coverage UC-020' without running a coverage audit
